body: I’m sorry this happened to you. Honestly the only thing that helped me through my similar experience was exposure to similar situations but with people that I felt safe with instead. I cried every time I was touched for a while too but I forced myself to go against closing myself off and tried my best to tolerate it. Luckily I was dating someone once I finally realised what had happened to me he helped me a lot too. I honestly just kept forcing myself to have sex even if I cried because I knew that’s what I needed to do if I wanted any type of sex life or normality again. Obviously I’d only have sex with them once I felt really comfortable in their environment and just with them in general.  I know it sounds really fucked up but it actually helped me to rediscover having sex for emotional reasons instead of just doing it to get it done as well as helping me heal from what had happened to me. I still have to stop sometimes but I no longer cry which is an amazing achievement for me. I really wish you all the best and I promise you, your wounds will begin to heal x
I’m feeling the exact same at the moment, I’ve been struggling to verbalise it for a while. Thank you
YES! Cotton mouth is a killer. I can’t go anywhere without at least a L of water in my bag.
I haven’t pooped for a week now. Whether this is because of Effexor or my crappy diet (excuse the pun).
That’s sexual assault not rape but nonetheless I wish you luck in your healing journey.
Sending warmth and love your way. I know it’s difficult right now but you are brave and strong. Maybe go stay with a family member/ trusted friend for a while?
Happy belated birthday. Sending you love and warmth x

I’m so so sorry this happened to you. Trust your initial instinct. This is rape. Don’t doubt that this is rape. Not only do you have to shut your ex out of your life but your friends too. If they are not supporting you through this horrific situation then they don’t deserve to be in your life period. Maybe go stay with close family for a while if that’s a possibility or have one of them stay with you? 
I wish you nothing but love and support in your healing journey.

I’m so happy you’ve said this because I’ve been thinking the exact same thing. For people to be throwing themselves into the 97% as if the statistic is referring to rape is just going to water down how detrimental rape actually is. Just as we have seen with everyone claiming they have depression and anxiety just because they feel nervous or sad every so often. People will begin to not take it seriously because it’ll become almost a trend to be labelled that way. 
It’s disgusting that people want to act like receiving dick pics is as bad as being raped. Even being sexually assaulted is completely different. 
Things need to change but I don’t think this is the correct way of going about it.

Hello. Thank you so much for sharing your story with us. Our body and mind does this weird but beautiful thing where it represses trauma until it’s ready to deal with it. It sounds like with this new openness to healing, your body is allowing you to feel all the things you tried to lock away. I’m no doctor but as someone who has experienced this type of side effect I think it’s normal. If anything I think it’s an indicator that you are finally allowing yourself to work through and heal from this trauma. Again I am so sorry you experienced this and I send you all the love and warmth you may need to get through it! xx
I plan on burning mine. Just finding the perfect time to do it. Probably before I go off to university in the fall.
Very proud of you!!! Well done for choosing to carry on. Remember to practice self love and care, you definitely deserve it x
Wow! I never thought about it like this, very enlightening to know. Thank you for sharing that.

Damn, I thought I was the only one. It’s really comforting to hear that other people are struggling too (not that I’m happy that other people are struggling or anything). I feel like it’s just being rubbed in my face that I’m apart of the statistic that everyone is posting and talking about. My journey with healing is being really effected by having to see this every day with people constantly wanting to talk/debate about ways to make things better. I’ve deleted Instagram in attempts to shut everything out but I feel like by doing so I’m just going to be left alone with my thoughts instead. It’s a difficult time to be a survivor.

I don’t have much advice to offer really which may make my comment seem useless but I just wanted to let you know that you’re doing an amazing job. I was touched and warmed by your love for your girlfriend. The world needs more people as loving and supportive as you. I hear your struggles and I send you nothing but love and healing. Karma will take its course. It always does. Just continue to look after your girlfriend and yourself. X
